QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] Hell Mode
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Longorias about the Fight for Azwan.
QuestInfo.1:
Enter Fight for Azwan on Hell Mode. Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k.

Hell Mode Guardian Tower #r#a39671##k
Hell Mode Mega Ballista #r#a39672##k

0.0: This battlefield is unlike any other. You will be risking your life just walking into this fight, but the people of Azwan still need you. Be brave, and you will survive.
0.1: Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k. This will be quite different than Hard Mode! I hope you're prepared.

no.0: You don't have to go if you're too scared.

1.0: You've lived through more than anyone else I've met. Hilla's soldiers get stronger as you approach her base, and the peoples' souls are in more pain. We must save them.

default.0: Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k.
